changeSet.author: thalabi
changeSet.createView: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY i.ticker) AS id, CASE WHEN i.type::text = 'STOCK'::text OR i.type::text = 'ETF'::text THEN i.ticker ELSE 'N/A'::character varying END AS ticker, i.name AS instrument_name, h.quantity, p.portfolio_id, p.name AS account_name FROM holding h JOIN instrument i ON h.instrument_id = i.id JOIN portfolio p ON h.portfolio_id = p.id WHERE i.ticker::text <> 'CASH'::text;

WITH latest_as_of_date_holding_inst_ids AS ( SELECT h2.instrument_id FROM holding h2 WHERE ((h2.as_of_date, h2.instrument_id, h2.portfolio_id) IN ( SELECT max(h.as_of_date) AS as_of_date, h.instrument_id, h.portfolio_id FROM holding h GROUP BY h.instrument_id, h.portfolio_id)) ) SELECT h.id, p.financial_institution AS portfolio_fi, p.holder AS portfolio_holder, p.name AS portfolio_name, p.portfolio_id AS portfolio_account_number, i.name AS instrument_name, iib.account_number AS instrument_account_number, iib.registered_account, i.currency, iib.type, iib.financial_institution AS issuer_fi, substr(iib.term::text, 6) AS term, iib.price, h.quantity, iib.interest_rate, iib.maturity_date, iib.promotional_interest_rate, iib.promotion_end_date, NULL::character varying(255) AS issuer_entity, NULL::character varying(9) AS cusip, NULL::numeric(10,4) AS coupon, NULL::timestamp(3) with time zone AS issue_date, NULL::character varying(255) AS payment_frequency, NULL::timestamp(3) with time zone AS next_payment_date, iib.email_notification, CASE WHEN iib.maturity_date IS NOT NULL THEN iib.maturity_date WHEN iib.promotion_end_date IS NOT NULL THEN iib.promotion_end_date ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone END::timestamp(3) with time zone AS due_date, i.notes FROM inst_interest_bearing iib JOIN instrument i ON iib.instrument_id = i.id JOIN holding h ON h.instrument_id = i.id JOIN latest_as_of_date_holding_inst_ids hi ON hi.instrument_id = i.id JOIN portfolio p ON h.portfolio_id = p.id UNION SELECT h.id, p.financial_institution AS portfolio_fi, p.holder AS portfolio_holder, p.name AS portfolio_name, p.portfolio_id AS portfolio_account_number, i.name AS instrument_name, NULL::character varying(16) AS instrument_account_number, NULL::character varying(4) AS registered_account, i.currency, 'BOND'::character varying(255) AS type, NULL::numeric(4,0) AS issuer_fi, NULL::character varying(6) AS term, ib.price, h.quantity, NULL::numeric(7,4) AS interest_rate, ib.maturity_date, NULL::numeric(7,4) AS promotional_interest_rate, NULL::timestamp(3) with time zone AS promotion_end_date, ib.issuer AS issuer_entity, ib.cusip, ib.coupon, ib.issue_date, ib.payment_frequency, ib.next_payment_date, ib.email_notification, ib.next_payment_date AS due_date, i.notes FROM inst_bond ib JOIN instrument i ON ib.instrument_id = i.id JOIN holding h ON h.instrument_id = i.id JOIN latest_as_of_date_holding_inst_ids hi ON hi.instrument_id = i.id JOIN portfolio p ON h.portfolio_id = p.id;
